title: Dawnshard
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A novella set in an existing epic fantasy world, following a young trader and a cheerful warrior on a ship bound for a mysterious island. It reads best after the earlier books in the series.
readIf: you like a sea voyage with a warm, funny crew and you are already reading this series.
skipIf: you are new to the Stormlight books, because it relies on context from them.

pairings.reason: The same author's whimsical sea adventure, which works as a standalone and has a similar bright tone.
The classic voyage to a dangerous island, for the same appetite for ship life and hidden stakes.
The series opener, for a reader who wants to see the wider story this novella belongs to.
